rules.sentence: The combination of temozolomide and bevacizumab, a recombinant monoclonal antibody targeting vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF), provided some of the first clinical evidence supporting the role of antiangiogenic therapy in SFTs.
In a retrospective series of 14 patients with locally advanced or metastatic hemangiopericytoma/SFT, tumor response was assessed using the Choi criteria on CT.
Sunitinib, a multityrosine kinase inhibitor targeting VEGFR and PDGFR, has demonstrated efficacy in retrospective series of patients with advanced SFT.
In 1 study of 35 patients, sunitinib achieved a median PFS of 6 months, with better responses observed in malignant SFTs than in DD-SFTs.

Sorafenib, a multikinase inhibitor targeting VEGF and platelet-derived growth factor (PDGF) receptors, has shown potential activity in advanced solitary fibrous tumors.

In a phase II French Sarcoma Group study, 2 of 5 patients with progressive malignant SFT achieved prolonged disease stabilization for approximately 9 months, with a median overall survival of 19.7 months.
